verdict.rationale: Kintsugi's docs show an exemption record API that captures exemption type, jurisdiction and validity dates, an endpoint to upload the certificate file, and a tax estimate that reflects the customer's exemptions. That covers storage and automatic application at calculation time. Collection and validation are not evidenced, and validity dates fall short of active expiry tracking. Missing for 10: a customer-facing certificate collection flow, certificate validation, expiry tracking or renewal alerts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
